description: AI Phone Agents for Healthcare Operations. Founded in 2023 by Xavier de Gracia and Josep Mingot, Prosper has 9 employees based in New York City. Prosper is hiring for 2 roles in sales.

founders.name: Xavier de Gracia
founders.title: Founder
founders.bio: Co-founder of Prosper, building AI agents to fix healthcare's $200B admin burden. Previously VP/GM of a $120M business unit, leading 800+ customer service agents, 300 phone sales reps, and 30+ ops staff. Advised healthcare PE and tech companies on GTM and operations at Bain & Co. MBA from Harvard, BBA from ESADE.

founders.name: Josep Mingot
founders.title: Founder
founders.bio: Co-founder of Prosper,  building AI agents to fix healthcare's $200B admin burden. Previously Product leader at Coverwallet (acq. by Aon), where I led the Insurance Health initiative that drove the acquisition, scaling the team from 3 PMs to 40+ and 200+ engineers. Co-founder of Arcvi, an AI consulting firm across Insurance, Health and Banking - top 2% in the Data Science Bowl for lung cancer image prediction. Former MIT Computer Vision research assistant.
